attempted_claim: Let f in S_k(Gamma_0(N)) be a newform of even weight k >= 4, square-free level N, trivial character, ordinary at an odd prime p with p not dividing N*D_K*c_f, p > k+1, p non-anomalous in the sense of Longo-Pati-Vigni Assumption 6.2, residual representation absolutely irreducible with big image and the ramification conditions at primes dividing M and D of loc. cit. Let K be an imaginary quadratic field of discriminant -D_K prime to Np satisfying the generalized Heegner hypothesis N = M*D with every prime dividing M split in K and D a square-free product of an even positive number of primes inert in K (indefinite quaternionic case, N^- > 1), and assume p is inert in K. Let K_infty/K be the anticyclotomic Z_p-extension, Lambda = O_p[[Gal(K_infty/K)]], T the self-dual twist of Deligne's p-adic representation of f, A = T tensor (F_p/O_p), and kappa_infty in Sel(K_infty,T) the inverse limit of regularized generalized Heegner classes on the Shimura curve X(M,D) of p-power conductor. Prove that kappa_infty is non-torsion, that rank_Lambda Sel(K_infty,T) = rank_Lambda Sel(K_infty,A)^vee = 1, and that char_Lambda((Sel(K_infty,A)^vee)_tors) divides, resp. equals, char_Lambda(Sel(K_infty,T)/Lambda*kappa_infty)^2 as ideals of Lambda.
decisive_failure: No complete or disproof result is claimed: the inert-p explicit reciprocity law, integral Perrin-Riou logarithm over unramified quadratic K_p, generic anticyclotomic nonvanishing, inert control theorem, and opposite divisibility all remain unproved, and the working notes establish only the location of the gap rather than any new theorem or verified computation.
